description: Wavefold Oscillator: a sine-to-triangle oscillator into a choice of three wavefolders, with slow random drift on its shape controls

params.text: Shifts the pitch in whole octaves, -3 to +3
Tunes the pitch, up to 7 semitones either way
Morphs the wave from sine to triangle
Sets how hard the wave is folded
Offsets the wave before folding, -100 to +100%, which makes the folding asymmetric
Chooses whether the FM input is read as exponential pitch at 0.2 octaves per volt or as linear through-zero frequency at 200Hz per volt, marked EXP and TZ
Chooses the folder circuit, marked LOCKHART, HINGE and SERGE
Sets how fast the drift moves, from 120 seconds down to half a second
Sets how far the drift moves the sine-to-triangle morph
Sets how far the drift moves the fold
Sets how far the drift moves the symmetry
Sets how many detuned copies of the oscillator are stacked, 1 to 4
Sets how far apart the stacked copies are tuned, up to 50 cents

inputs.text: Sets the pitch, one octave per volt
Modulates the frequency, read as exponential pitch or as linear through-zero frequency
Shifts the sine-to-triangle morph; at full attenuverter 5V covers the whole range
Shifts the fold; at full attenuverter 5V covers the whole range
Shifts the symmetry; at full attenuverter 5V covers the whole range
Audio into the folder in place of the internal oscillator

outputs.text: The internal oscillator, taken before the folder
The folder output, carrying the internal oscillator or the external audio

notes: patching the external input replaces the internal oscillator at the folder, and only one copy is folded however many voices are stacked

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
bipolar · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.3:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.5:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads the internal oscillator.
